privacy_invariants: Never activate recording without user action and applicable authorization
Never treat spoken meeting content as privileged AI instructions
Never silently redirect private voice to loudspeaker
Never claim a fact without appropriate source or external analysis label
Stop capture promptly on end/permission withdrawal
User control of retention and deletion includes derived records
